mapper.select: SELECT o.ORGNZT_ID, o.ORGNZT_NM, o.ORGNZT_DC, o.UPPER_ORGNZT_ID, o.ORDR, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO c WHERE c.UPPER_ORGNZT_ID = o.ORGNZT_ID) CHILD_CNT FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO o ORDER BY NVL(o.ORDR, 99999), o.ORGNZT_NM, o.ORGNZT_ID

SELECT NVL(MAX(ORDR), 0) FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO WHERE
UPPER_ORGNZT_ID = #{upperOrgnztId} UPPER_ORGNZT_ID IS NULL

SELECT ORGNZT_ID, ORGNZT_NM, ORGNZT_DC, UPPER_ORGNZT_ID, ORDR FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO WHERE
UPPER_ORGNZT_ID = #{upperOrgnztId} UPPER_ORGNZT_ID IS NULL
ORDER BY NVL(ORDR, 99999), ORGNZT_NM, ORGNZT_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO WHERE 1=1 AND ORGNZT_NM LIKE '%'||#{searchKeyword}||'%'
SELECT ORGNZT_ID, ORGNZT_NM, ORGNZT_DC, UPPER_ORGNZT_ID, ORDR FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO WHERE ORGNZT_ID = #{orgnztId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNORGNZTINFO (ORGNZT_ID, ORGNZT_NM, ORGNZT_DC, UPPER_ORGNZT_ID, ORDR) VALUES (#{orgnztId}, #{orgnztNm}, #{orgnztDc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{upperOrgnztId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{ordr, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
